description: VOYO, the first Slovenian subscription video on demand, is the richest treasure trove of video content with a selected offer of blockbusters, popular series, reality shows, cartoons for the youngest, sports and hits of domestic production. Video content can be viewed by signing up for a 30-day subscription to VOYO.si. Once you have access to VOYO.si, you can simply connect your online account to the application on your Windows 8 device and enjoy watching video content on demand.
